card.text: A star 25% of the Sun's width that turns once in 9.72 hours, with a mapped magnetic field.

introduction.text: Morin et al. give it 0.25 solar radii, 0.25 solar masses, a rotation period of 9.72 hours and an axis tilted 60° from the line of sight.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.

radial-field-2006-08.title: Radial field, Aug 2006
radial-field-2006-08.summary: The star's magnetic field, mapped in this project from archived spectra by how it polarises starlight.
